environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EKS with default securityContext. Container runs as root with default Docker capabilities. Service is exposed via NodePort on port 30080 with no ingress controller or WAF. Pod spec uses default serviceAccount with no network policies applied. WebSocket endpoint accessible from any origin.

config.capabilities: default docker set (includes CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN among others)
